*Important Milestone Expected to Expand Institutional Visibility, Broaden Retail Investor Awareness and Strengthen Eagle’s Position as an Emerging Leader in U.S. Uranium and Advanced Nuclear Energy*


RENO, Nev., Nov. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) —[Eagle Nuclear Energy Corp.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=SqgPhw9swuxADLkMYBLx6ksNgLT_panSWNvsRZHQnf6go1i0y26MamVY0HlItPaW5dxqT-x8boMNhL8WOv5KrKMcVsuizXCYFQQ5ipqlusY=) (“Eagle” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: NUCL), a next-generation nuclear energy company, today announced that it has been added as a member of the Russell Microcap® Index, which will become effective after the US market closes on December 11, 2026, as part of the 2026 Russell indexes reconstitution.


Membership in the Russell Microcap® Index is maintained for a one-year period and provides automatic inclusion in the corresponding growth and value style indexes. FTSE Russell determines eligibility for its Russell indexes primarily through objective market capitalization rankings and established style criteria.


“Being selected for inclusion in the Russell Microcap® Index marks an important milestone for Eagle and reflects the continued progress we are making in advancing our vision for an integrated nuclear energy platform,” said Eagle CEO Mark Mukhija. “We believe this recognition will help increase awareness of Eagle and the work we’re doing to advance our uranium projects and explore opportunities in advanced nuclear technology. As interest in nuclear energy continues to grow, we remain focused on building our business and creating long-term value for our shareholders.”


Russell indexes are widely utilized by investment managers and institutional investors for index funds and as benchmarks for active investment strategies. Approximately $9 trillion in assets are benchmarked against Russell’s US indexes. Russell indexes are part of FTSE Russell, a leading global index provider.


For additional information regarding the Russell Microcap® Index and the Russell indexes reconstitution, go to the “Russell Reconstitution” section of the[FTSE Russell website](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=AQT59RpMhdBscJxPl1IsHVJ5KXp0IC9NkSQyl76FjqORlHkq9Tj50SiRytoEvB9ViOm3m0pq0eHob1InL-TIMBU8w42VztGMwPGBDGyV14mY7elxur1-lpJ8g-2A0g_Olqkwv8qhZt8r5k36yMVLRg==) .


**About Eagle Nuclear Energy Corp.**


Eagle Nuclear Energy Corp. is a next-generation nuclear energy company that combines domestic uranium exploration with access to certain Small Modular Reactor (SMR) technology. The Company owns the largest conventional, measured and indicated uranium deposit in the United States, located in southeastern Oregon. This includes the Aurora deposit, with 32.75Mlbs Indicated and 4.98Mlbs Inferred (SK-1300 TRS) of near-surface uranium resource, and the adjacent Cordex deposit, which the Company believes offers potential to expand the project’s overall resource inventory. By integrating advanced SMR technology with a sizeable uranium asset, Eagle is building an integrated nuclear platform positioned to support domestic nuclear energy development.


For more information about Eagle Nuclear Energy Corp., visit[www.eaglenuclear.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=AJGGon5ifbTchLHicKOJ56MxXqzvWWH2w1vYtycCevOBnhObC4mjZMlmMWP7uk5aV5Lo_GgWw_cNq_4dEEQB-CN8qFMIBNKhUNmFHkw8nJk=) .
